issues.display_title: Issue #1624: Create Reset Password New Layout
issues.main_description_html:
Create Reset Password New Layout

Objective: Redesign the Reset Password screen (set a new password using the token from the reset email).

Redesign layout old from: https://villume.com/reset-password

Notes: New password + confirm password (show/hide), strength/min-length hints, submit. Handle invalid/expired token state.

Redesign concept (applies to all)

  • Redesign the OLD layout into the NEW Villume design language (same system as Login/Signup/Welcome).
  • Design system: Geist / Geist Mono typography, design tokens, light & dark theme.
  • Part of the password-reset flow; keep it visually consistent with the auth pages (centered confirm layout or two-column auth layout as appropriate).
  • Fully responsive (mobile / tablet / desktop).
  • Visual/layout redesign only — keep existing fields/behavior.
  • Deliverable: UI design/layout (mockup) ready for slicing & integration.

RESULT

issues.display_title: Issue #1658: Create Support Menu “Clients” New Layout
issues.main_description_html:
Basically, a layout redesign.

Redesign the layout of the Support → Clients screen (the internal user-support panel at /support).

Context (from docs/04-06-2026/analyze-pages-old.md):

  • Route: /support · Guard: AuthSupportGuard (support staff only)
  • Purpose: Internal user-support panel — search/filter users, view their history, and log in as a user for troubleshooting.
  • Part of villume-admin (Angular 16 SSR). Reached from the header Support submenu (“Clients”).

Scope: Visual/layout redesign only — modernize the Clients (user search/management) screen. No change to support functionality or AuthSupportGuard access.

Acceptance:

  • Clients screen rebuilt on the new layout/design.
  • Existing support actions (search/filter users, view history, log in as user) preserved.
  • Access still restricted by AuthSupportGuard.

RESULT
